frozen_before: any numerical study output of this directory; feasibility.py refuses to run if this file's digest differs from the one it records at first run
status_of_numbers: research design assumptions for a feasibility study; not adopted product requirements; not a change to first-case-obligation-v0.2
question: Can a deployment-change decision obtain useful, valid confirmation at materially lower complete cost than the finite condition-by-condition obligation, and under which decision contract and assumptions?

existing_contract_preserved.name: first-case-obligation-v0.2
existing_contract_preserved.form: finite conjunction: the frozen candidate completes the registered failure after the freeze, completes every fresh condition the reference completes, and satisfies progress, constraint, timing and scope predicates on every assigned run; 32 fresh paired conditions plus 3 post-freeze reproduction runs = 67 runs per candidate
existing_contract_preserved.statistical_claim: none; an acceptance covers the declared conditions only

O1_harmful_disagreement_bound.estimand: p_minus = P(reference succeeds and candidate fails) on the fresh-condition distribution
O1_harmful_disagreement_bound.hypotheses: H0: p_minus >= q (harmful); H1: p_minus < q; accept the candidate only by rejecting H0 at level alpha
O1_harmful_disagreement_bound.note: q = 0.0893682 is the one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound after 32 concordant pairs, the certification the current 32-pair zero-regression outcome already implies under i.i.d. seeds

O2_non_inferiority_of_success.estimand: g = p_plus - p_minus = E[S(candidate) - S(reference)] on the fresh-condition distribution
O2_non_inferiority_of_success.hypotheses: H0: g <= -epsilon; H1: g > -epsilon (accept by rejecting H0); superiority variant H0: g <= 0 reported alongside

O3_mean_progress_superiority.estimand: E[R1] - E[R0] for a bounded progress metric R in [0, 1]
O3_mean_progress_superiority.role: the objective N-SCORE answers; included to show it is a different question from O1, O2 and the finite obligation

absolute_requirements_not_averaged: the registered failure condition is fixed (candidate completes it)
progress, constraint, timing and scope predicates hold on every executed run
declared protected groups each satisfy O1 and O2 separately

sampling_unit_and_pairing.unit: one fresh condition (seed) executed under both the reference and the candidate deployment from the same recorded initial state
sampling_unit_and_pairing.pair_outcome: X = S(candidate) - S(reference) in {-1, 0, +1}; both members of every pair are charged
sampling_unit_and_pairing.within_pair_dependence: allowed by every procedure used (paired binomial, betting martingale on X)
sampling_unit_and_pairing.across_pair_assumption: conditions are independent draws from a fixed fresh-condition distribution, candidate and reference frozen, scoring frozen; this is assumed for the statistical contracts and is not established by any digest

error_allocation.O1: one-sided binomial tail at alpha for a single comparison (m = 1)
error_allocation.O2: four Clopper-Pearson tails at beta = alpha / (4 m) with m = 1, following When Validation Stops Learning (arXiv:2609.10873v1) equation 2
error_allocation.sequential: one Ville threshold 1/alpha per test; no alpha re-use across attempts; a retry needs fresh data and its own allocation
error_allocation.attempts: one frozen candidate per study; changing the candidate ends the test

procedures.F0_finite_conjunction: the existing obligation as implemented; cost 67 runs when accepted; early termination on an observed violation is evaluated separately
procedures.F1_fixed_exact_binomial_O1: Clopper-Pearson one-sided upper bound on p_minus after n pairs; accept if the bound is < q; reject if the exact lower bound exceeds q; otherwise defer
procedures.F2_fixed_paired_binomial_O2: equation 2 of arXiv:2609.10873v1: L = l(k_plus) - u(k_minus), U = u(k_plus) - l(k_minus); accept if L >= -epsilon; reject if U < -epsilon; else defer
procedures.S1_sequential_sprt_O1: Wald likelihood ratio between p_minus = q and p_minus = 0 on the harmful indicator; accept when the ratio reaches 1/alpha; any harmful disagreement sets the ratio to zero (reject); exactly valid under optional stopping by Ville's inequality
procedures.S2_sequential_betting_O2: test supermartingale X_{n+1} = X_n (1 + xi (X_pair + epsilon)) with a fixed predictable xi in a small grid, threshold 1/alpha, following the evidence-integrator form of N-SCORE (arXiv:2603.13616v1) equation 3 shifted by the margin; this is not N-SCORE's optimized xi_n and not its code
procedures.S3_sequential_betting_O3: the same integrator on bounded progress differences without a margin; N-SCORE's stated objective; reported only for the mean-versus-obligation witness
procedures.P1_peeking_fixed_interval: F1 applied after every pair and stopping at the first acceptance; an invalid procedure included to measure the inflation of erroneous acceptance

stopping_rules.fixed: decide once at n pairs; n in the grid
stopping_rules.sequential: stop at the first n <= n_max where the statistic crosses 1/alpha (accept) or the process reaches zero (reject); otherwise defer at n_max

scenario_grid.description: paired outcome distributions (p_plus, p_minus, p_concordant); protected groups as mixtures; every scenario retained whether or not any procedure gains

computation: exact enumeration over the (n, k_plus, k_minus) lattice for every fixed-rate rule; no random trials; the group scenario is enumerated on the mixture and per group

cost_units.runs: one closed-loop execution; a pair is two runs; the finite obligation adds three reproduction runs per candidate
cost_units.wall: projected from the retained per-run own-trial wall of the historical comparisons; a projection, not measured end-to-end savings

real_record_check.role: applicability, data quality and retrospective calculation; not fresh evidence and not independent incidents
real_record_check.selection: the ten development-ablation-001 confirmations per arm that reached a confirmation (D01, D02, D03, D04, D05, D07, D09 in arms A and B), pinned by the comparison score digest b244cec83a6ed6ce7aec6ea6b4adba530f40058122334feb5968fa9abdb8b31a
real_record_check.quantities: k_plus, k_minus, both-failed count, the exact retrospective certification each rule supports at n = 32, the sequential stopping index under the recorded run order, and the first violating pair index for rejected candidates

decision_criteria.go: a named valid procedure reaches an accept boundary for a meaningful contract at materially lower run cost than 67 at equal or stated certification, on the scenario grid and consistent with the real records
decision_criteria.narrow: an existing method provides the benefit; incorporate and narrow the claimed contribution
decision_criteria.stop: the objective, budget or assumptions prevent useful confirmation at lower cost; name the limit and the smallest change that would matter
